$comment: What this repository took from the factory, and when. /update-agents reads the version here, compares it against the factory release you name, and proposes the difference as a pull request. The roles in .claude/agents/, the skills in .claude/skills/, and the commands in .claude/commands/ are the real thing; this is the record of where they came from. Two fields are read at run time. `labels` is the vocabulary this release's preflight matches on, and the session-start hook compares it against the labels the repository actually has - because only `bootstrap` creates a label, and only a person can run `bootstrap`. `runner` says who starts an agent run: `session` means a session does, through /dispatch, and the agent-run workflow stands down; `actions` means a label starts the workflow, which spends the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN secret. It is this repository's setting rather than the release's, and /update-agents keeps whatever it says.
